name: xunitrevit
description: Run xUnit tests inside Autodesk Revit from VS Code. Discovers tests, launches Revit in headless mode, and displays results in Test Explorer.

xunitRevit.revitVersion.description: Revit version to use for test execution.

xunitRevit.timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for Revit to complete tests.

xunitRevit.testScriptPath.description: Path to run-revit-tests.ps1. If empty, searches the workspace root.

xunitRevit.sshTarget.description: SSH target (user@host) for remote Revit execution. Empty = local.

xunitRevit.skipBuild.description: Skip build step and use already-deployed DLLs.
